title: Orbital Gardens: Cooperative Rescue

foundation.history: A forgotten ring garden habitat once protected hydroponic nutrients, until recurring life-support imbalance forced residents to abandon it.

premise: Ena Oriel, a responder, must coordinate multiple rescue teams, relying on role synchronization despite life-support imbalance.
central_conflict: a cascading emergency threatens the ring garden habitat by restricting hydroponic nutrients.

plot_beats.name: Discovery
plot_beats.cause: life-support imbalance destroys the primary approach
plot_beats.effect: The player must choose an alternative entry

plot_beats.name: Competing truths
plot_beats.cause: a cascading emergency contests access to hydroponic nutrients
plot_beats.effect: The protagonist must reconcile independent testimony

plot_beats.name: Reconstruction
plot_beats.cause: The ring garden habitat becomes operable
plot_beats.effect: The choice of stewardship rewrites the alliance map

endings.consequence: Locals create an autonomous stewardship cooperative
Survival is proven but structural inequity remains
